title: The lead comes first and each technician shows only once
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  • Technicians: 2 eligible technicians at this location, named as the expected results name them: "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards". A technician is eligible when Time Clock is on, the staff member is active (not deactivated), the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Lead First Once" (used by this case only), with one contact and one asset.
  • Work order [WO-1] for this customer: status Approved; Lead Technician Esther Howard; three lines — "Line 1" given to Esther Howard, "Line 2" and "Line 3" both given to Ralph Edwards.
  • What must hold: Esther Howard is both lead and a line technician; Ralph Edwards is on two lines. The line names are examples.

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm each technician below exists and is eligible, or add them with New Staff Member: First Name and Last Name ("Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards") and an email; a Role that is not Office User or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"); at least one Department (required); Location = this location; Time Clock on > Save & Close.
  2. Top menu Customers > New Customer, Name "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Lead First Once" > Save (skip if it already exists). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Record the customer as [Cust-1].
  3. Create a work order with three lines: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in New Work Order pick Customer [Cust-1] and its Asset > Save. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open: in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line, turn Line Approved on (this makes the work order Approved) > Save & Add Line for the next line or Save & Close. Record the number shown as [WO-1]. Line names in this case (such as "Line 1") are only labels for you: the New Line form's "What Are You Doing?" box only offers ready-made lines (typed text finds no results), so pick any ready-made line for each one (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot") and write down which is which.
  4. On [WO-1] pick Lead Technician "Esther Howard". Lead Technician on the work order page is read-only while the work order is an Estimate; once it is Approved it is a Lead Technician dropdown.
  5. Give "Line 1" to Esther Howard, and "Line 2" and "Line 3" both to Ralph Edwards (Edit Line > Technicians).
  6. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Lead First Once" in Search — exactly [WO-1] shows, Approved, Lead Technician Esther Howard; on its Lines tab Line 1 shows Esther Howard and Lines 2 and 3 show Ralph Edwards. If it does not match, fix the work order (or create it again) before starting.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View").
  2. Type [Cust-1] ("ZZAUTOTEST F3 Lead First Once") in Search.
  3. Turn line technicians on in Fields to display.
  4. Read the avatars in order and hover each one.
  5. Pick Tech View with Assigned Techs on (Column Selection > Assigned Techs) and do the same.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The group shows 2 avatars: Esther Howard first, then Ralph Edwards.
  • Esther Howard appears once although she is lead and on a line, and Ralph Edwards appears once although he is on two lines.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10050 (Story 7, Show line technicians on cards and rows); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S7-R3, S7-R5, S7-E1, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions FF-8 / DR-11. Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R3: “Place the lead technician first in the avatar group.”
  • S7-R5: “Show each technician once, even when they are both lead and assigned to lines.”
  • S7-E1: “A technician assigned to several lines of the same work order appears once.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
